itemized.notes: AMENDMENT to the September 15, 2014 interim (the cover checks the amendment 'Yes' box). PAGE ORDER: p3 = blank Schedule A form with 'See Attached' (its TOTAL cell holds the typed 10,860.25); p4 = blank Schedule B form with 'See Attached' (TOTAL 10,145.02); p5 = the contributions spreadsheet; p6-p7 = the expenditures spreadsheet. REDACTION: on all three attachment pages a wide black bar covers the whole address block - donor_city and donor_state are blank with 'redacted' noted; no city or state value survives anywhere. TEN of the 42 contribution rows are not named donors at all: the first-name cell prints 'Aggregate' and the surname cell 'Contribution of $50 or Less' - sub-threshold buckets, transcribed verbatim with needs_review=1, never given a fabricated name. IN-KIND: 9 contribution rows and 8 expenditure rows carry an explicit 'In Kind' marker, and they PAIR ACROSS THE TWO SIDES to the cent (30.75 Steve Beck / FedEx labels; 24.90 Stephen Nelson / Taiwan Imports; 53.92 Matt Bates / Costco water; 16.27 Natalee Nelson / Walmart popsicles; 7.77 Natalee Nelson / Walmart parade supplies; 25.89 aggregate / Costco cookies; 268.67 Holly Petrik / Hilton & Harmons meet-and-greet) - the filer booked each in-kind gift on both schedules, which is why both sides reconcile exactly. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: p5 42 dates / 42 name pairs / 42 amounts, with each occupation cell confirmed against its vertical position (the ten Aggregate rows correctly carry an EMPTY occupation, and every blank occupation lines up with an Aggregate or unnamed row); p6 33/33/33/33 and p7 17/17/17/17 - PASS. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on all attachment rows (landscape scans; back-converted portrait bands could not be pinned tighter than the row pitch).
